Geography

Published workflow

The Green Mop offers weekly and biweekly home cleaning, with whole-home or selected-room scopes and hourly pricing. Its contact page asks customers to email their preferred dates and explains that crews usually contain two cleaners, sometimes three, with an arrival window confirmed by dispatch.

Why it fits

Proposed first demonstration: enter one weekly and one biweekly customer, retain each property's room scope and hourly estimate notes, assign a two-person crew, then move one dated visit without changing its recurring series. Use BroomDesk's lead form for an initial inquiry and let the office confirm the estimate and arrival window. Finish by showing the cleaner's instructions and the completed visit history. This gives the owner a concrete way to assess recurring scheduling and dispatch while preserving the company's current pricing and confirmation process. Product reference: https://broomdesk.com/features/scheduling and https://broomdesk.com/features/booking-widget.
